item.title: Boy, 10, stable after being shot in the chest at southeast Atlanta home
item.description: A 10-year-old boy is fighting for his life after being shot in the chest at a southeast Atlanta home early Sunday morning. Atlanta police are searching for three suspects who allegedly left the scene of the shooting in a silver sedan.Officers responded to the home in the 100 block of Ruzelle Drive SE around 6:45 a.m. for a shots-fired call.When they arrived, they found the boy suffering from a gunshot wound in his chest. item.title: Troup deputies capture accused child molester who escaped jail
item.description: Authorities captured an accused child molester who escaped from the Troup County Jail on Sunday morning. Christian Joel Marcos Cortez, 20, escaped from the jail property around 4:42 a.m., deputies said.Deputies received a tip that he may have traveled to Acworth, and around 9:20 p.m., he was captured by the Cherokee County Sheriff's Office. item.title: Alleged shooter charged after ambush, standoff leaves 2 Atlanta police officers injured
item.description: A 23-year-old man remains behind bars after authorities say he ambushed two Atlanta police officers Saturday morning at an apartment complex. Two officers responded to an apartment complex in the 2400 block of Cheshire Bridge Road around 7:30 a.m. When they arrived, police found signs of gunfire in one of the apartments and entered to investigate. item.title: Falcons rookie linebacker James Pearce Jr. arrested near Miami following alleged domestic dispute
item.description: Atlanta Falcons star rookie linebacker James Pearce Jr. was arrested Saturday near Miami after leading police on a chase that ended in a crash following a domestic dispute with WNBA player Rickea Jackson, according to the Associated Press. Pearce, 23, was booked into the Turner Guilford Knight Correctional Center at 6:58 p.m. on Saturday. item.title: Feds buy Social Circle facility for new ICE detention center, officials say
item.description: The US Department of Homeland Security has reportedly completed its purchase of a metro Atlanta facility it intends to turn into an immigration detention center, officials said. item.description: A young woman was found shot to death on Kings Highway over the weekend, authorities said. item.title: Federal judge orders Fulton County election raid warrant unsealed
item.description: A federal judge has ordered the unsealing of a federal search warrant allowing FBI agents to seize hundreds of documents related to the 2020 election.The order states that the federal government no longer opposes the warrant's unsealing, and that it must be filed on Feb. 10.
